result_text:
In `getAllTeams` (`LandscapeAnalysisResults.java`), the "Undefined Team" now only takes unmatched contributors for whom `Contributor.isActive()` is true. The module compiles. I didn't run any tests or write a new one for this.

The change is one extra condition on the remainder branch. Configured teams are untouched, so they keep all their members. A blank latest-commit date already counts as active in `DateUtils.isDateWithinRange`, so nobody is dropped for missing data.

The early return when no teams are configured is unchanged. In that case the method still returns all contributors, active or not.
